item.title: GBAMZ — Game Boy Emulator in C
item.description:
Overview

Implemented a Game Boy emulator in C, focusing on accurate CPU emulation and system architecture.

Key Contributions

  • CPU Implementation: Implemented the complete Game Boy CPU instruction set with cycle-accurate timing

  • Memory Management: Developed memory mapping and bank switching mechanisms

  • Interrupt Handling: Built the interrupt controller for proper system event handling

Technical Details

The emulator faithfully reproduces the Game Boy’s Z80-derived CPU, implementing all opcodes and memory-mapped I/O for peripheral interaction.
